tools.name: find_clinics
tools.description: Find clinics near a place, in a town or by name, nearest first. Each clinic has its clinic_id, address, distance, phone numbers with call/SMS/WhatsApp channels, hours today, open now and rating. Give near (latitude/longitude) or place (a town, place name or four-digit postal code). With treatment_id

tools.name: get_clinic
tools.description: One clinic's facts: address, phones, the week's opening hours (also odd and even weeks), closed days, parking, team, treatment categories with prices, current offers, payment methods, cancellation notice, gift cards and subscriptions.

tools.name: find_practitioners
tools.description: Find a practitioner by name (at least two letters) and the clinics where each can be booked now. For who can do one treatment option, with prices, use get_booking_choices.

tools.name: search_treatments
tools.description: Search treatments in Norwegian and English at once; spelling mistakes and compound words are handled. Each result has its treatment_id, category path, price from-to, offer price, duration, clinic count and, with near or place, the nearest clinics. Filter by category, body_area or skin_concern (brows

tools.name: get_treatment
tools.description: One treatment: what it is, the procedure, recovery and safety, sessions and interval, its options with option_id, price, offer price and duration, the clinics that offer it and its reviews. Every option has a booking_url.

tools.name: get_booking_choices
tools.description: The choices the booking lightbox offers for one option_id. Without a clinic: every clinic that can book it, with distance, practitioner count and prices. With clinic_id: the practitioners with their own prices (practitioner_id), add-ons, packages, party size, cancellation notice and payment methods.

tools.name: find_free_days
tools.description: Which days have a free time for one option_id, for up to 60 days, at clinic_id or at the three nearest clinics to near or place. For one practitioner_id or anyone; add_on_ids lengthen the visit. No free day gives a waitlist_url.

tools.name: find_free_times
tools.description: The free times on a date (or up to 7 days) for one option_id at clinic_id, with the practitioners free at each time and their prices. Every time has a booking_url that opens the booking lightbox with the option, practitioner, day, time and add-ons chosen. A time is not held until the person books it

tools.name: list_offers
tools.description: The live offers (campaigns), with each treatment or product, its price before and after, and until when it holds. Filter by clinic_id, item_type or item_slug; offer_id reads one offer.

tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Search skincare and retail products: GLØDI's marketplace on glodi.no and each clinic's shop on its own site. Filter by brand, category or stock. product_id reads one product with its description, sellers, subscription options, matching treatments and reviews.

tools.name: list_events
tools.description: Upcoming arrangements and courses, GLØDI's own and the clinics', with sessions, seats left, price from and registration state. event_id reads one event with its program, prerequisites and price tiers.

tools.name: list_reviews
tools.description: Published reviews and their summary (average, count, distribution) for one clinic_id, practitioner, treatment_id or product_id.

tools.name: browse_site
tools.description: The map of everything public here: every list page with its count, and the treatment categories, body areas and skin concerns with their slugs, for vague needs ("pigmentering", "acne"). Also the contact facts and, on glodi.no, GLØDI's plans for clinics.

tools.name: read_public_page
tools.description: Read one public page, normally a URL another answer returned: its text sections, links, schema.org facts and typed data for the page type (clinic, treatment, practitioner, offer, product, brand, event, guide, article, ingredient or job).

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_treatment, search_products, list_reviews, read_public_page · Private data: browse_site · Public sink: find_clinics.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_treatment, search_products, list_reviews, read_public_page · Private data: browse_site · Public sink: find_clinics

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
